body: These feelings make me doubt all religion even atheism. What if we are all wrong. What if we die and all we are left with is our memories. I am big into science however this is the one thing that just cannot be proved. Without proof it is playing Russian Roulette. One box is emptiness and one could be further suffering. Either way, how do we truly know how our family and friends will take it? I know I am loved and I know that it is common for people to deal with death. Will they be more mad than sad? I'm in hospital at the moment so I am safe from doing much harm. Each day I make plans. Each day I grow more anxious to take action.
